description: This file contains functions and type definitions for performing security scans during plugin and skill installation processes, including directory and file scanning, hook execution, and decision logic for blocking or allowing installations based on scan results.

classes.name: InstallScanLogger
classes.description: Logger interface for warning messages during scans.

classes.name: InstallScanFinding
classes.description: Represents a security finding with rule ID, severity, file, line, and message.

classes.name: BuiltinInstallScan
classes.description: Represents the result of a security scan, including status, findings, and counts.

methods.name: buildCriticalDetails
methods.description: Builds a string of critical findings for reporting.

methods.name: buildCriticalBlockReason
methods.description: Generates a reason string for blocking due to critical findings.

methods.name: buildScanFailureBlockReason
methods.description: Creates a reason string for scan failure blocking.

methods.name: buildBuiltinScanFromError
methods.description: Constructs a scan result object from an error.

methods.name: buildBuiltinScanFromSummary
methods.description: Constructs a scan result object from a summary.

methods.name: scanDirectoryTarget
methods.description: Performs a directory scan and returns scan results.

methods.name: buildBlockedScanResult
methods.description: Determines if scan results should block installation.

methods.name: logDangerousForceUnsafeInstall
methods.description: Logs a warning when unsafe installation is forced despite dangerous findings.

methods.name: resolveBuiltinScanDecision
methods.description: Decides whether to block installation based on scan and override settings.

methods.name: runBeforeInstallHook
methods.description: Runs plugin hooks before installation, possibly blocking the process.

methods.name: scanBundleInstallSourceRuntime
methods.description: Scans a plugin bundle source directory and runs pre-install hooks.

methods.name: scanPackageInstallSourceRuntime
methods.description: Scans a plugin package directory with extensions and runs pre-install hooks.

methods.name: scanFileInstallSourceRuntime
methods.description: Scans a specific plugin file and runs pre-install hooks.

methods.name: scanSkillInstallSourceRuntime
methods.description: Scans a skill source directory and runs pre-install hooks.
